summary_en: 3,800,000 shares (2.36% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥2,981/share (closing price Aug 6) for a maximum of ¥11.33B. Execution on Aug 7, 2026, 08:45 JST. All acquired shares scheduled for cancellation by end-Sep 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-hour trades (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: NOK Corporation's board of directors resolved on August 6, 2026 to acquire treasury shares via an off-hours block trade under ToSTNeT-3 on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company will place an order to purchase up to 3,800,000 shares at the closing price of ¥2,981 per share on August 6 during the ToSTNeT-3 session commencing at 08:45 JST on August 7, 2026. The maximum purchase price is ¥11.327 billion (3,800,000 shares × ¥2,981), representing 2.36% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). The issuer states the acquisition is to improve capital efficiency and enterprise value in accordance with its capital allocation policy. All shares acquired in this block trade are scheduled to be cancelled by the end of September 2026.
